title: Newark criminal record screening limits for rental housing
requirement: A landlord or broker may inquire into an applicant's criminal history only after a formal application, and may consider only indictable convictions within 8 years and disorderly persons convictions within 5 years. Written notice and at least 3 business days to respond are required.
coverage_conditions: Any rental, lease, or sublease of real property in Newark, except renting a unit in an owner-occupied two-family dwelling or a room in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling.

coverage_quotes: the provisions of this Article shall not apply to the rental:
Of a single apartment or flat in a two family dwelling, the other occupancy unit of which is occupied by the owner as his/her residence
Of a room or rooms to another person or persons by the owner or occupant of one-family dwelling occupied by him/her as his/her residence

exemptions: Federal or state law requiring or permitting consideration of criminal history, limited to those offenses and periods; property designated to participate in a government program encouraging housing for individuals with criminal histories.
penalty: First violation: fine up to $500. Each subsequent violation: fine up to $1,000.
citation: Newark, NJ, Rev. Gen. Ordinances ch. 2:31, art. 1
quoted_span: Indictable offense convictions in New Jersey (or, if from any other state or jurisdiction, convictions for conduct which, if committed in New Jersey, would constitute an indictable offense) for eight years following the release from post-conviction custody or from the date of sentencing if the person was not incarcerated;
